title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
abstract: arXiv:2610.40476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. translated_title: 在模拟环境中训练语言模型用于精神科接诊
translated_abstract: 在精神科临床实践中，临床接诊访谈仍然是主要的诊断工具，要求临床医生在建立融洽关系的同时，理清复杂且相互重叠的症状表现。本研究表明，在模拟环境中进行的多轮强化学习（RL）能够提升语言模型在基于文本的结构化精神科接诊任务上的表现，涵盖病史采集、鉴别诊断和初步治疗计划制定。在一项随机、双盲交叉研究中（N = 60 组匹配场景，共 120 次接诊），我们将经过强化学习训练的智能体与其使用相同提示词的基础模型进行比较：32 名获得委员会认证的精神科医生扮演标准化病人，并由另一个由 15 名独立的、获得委员会认证的精神科医生组成的评审小组对去标识化的访谈记录进行评分。经过训练的智能体在 76.7% 的匹配场景中优于基础模型（p < 0.0001），并在改编的临床考核评分标准上取得了提升（d_z =
tldr: 本研究通过在模拟环境中进行多轮强化学习训练语言模型，显著提升了其在精神科接诊访谈中的表现，在双盲交叉研究中于76.7%的匹配场景中优于基础模型。
en_tdlr: Multi-turn reinforcement learning in simulation environments substantially improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, outperforming its base model in 76.7% of matched scenarios in a randomized double-blind crossover study evaluated by board-certified psychiatrists.
